AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

NEW each instance of this same Lesser Antimagic field is exempt from suppression by this same family, so overlapping fields form the union of their active volumes rather than an oscillating mutual shutdown. This exemption permits maintaining an existing field, not creating new magic from within another already-active field. Independent effects that specifically suppress this field apply by their own rules. Concentration maintenance itself remains possible inside; field creation does not cancel remote already-established effects merely because their concentrating caster entered. It suppresses the actual local expression/affected component, not a distant source solely through caster ownership. A creature-attached magical benefit/condition or discrete magical item is wholly suppressed while any of that body/item's actual occupied volume intersects the covered sphere; a large freestanding area/barrier is suppressed only in its actual intersection. A merely overlapping target space does not suppress unrelated creatures elsewhere. Created summons use their source's suppression placement/history rules; real animated bodies become inert only if their actual animation source says so. Magic items retain their mundane body/profile and inventory while their actual magical enhancements/actions are unavailable; intrinsic mundane functions do not vanish. If no ordinary fallback profile exists, do not fabricate one as an extra weapon/armor entitlement. Nonmagical class abilities, learned facts, RP maxima/records, physical injuries, completed ordinary material creation/transmutation, finished teleportation, restoredHP and consumed items are not rolled back. A continuing spell curse is suppressed only in its magical components; a persistent mundane disease or intrinsic nonmagical trait is not automatically cured. A present magical tempHP/buffer grant is unavailable while suppressed but retains its remaining balance and original ending; no damage then absorbed from it, no later refund of HP loss. The ordinary single-grant/strongest-buffer records still apply to another actual accepted grant, with no second hidden usable bank. Suppressing a changed body uses the reviewed body/root/meld/placement rules; it does not clone gear or close-and-recapture its meld set. A legal spell cast may still be committed inside if its ordinary nonmagical casting permissions/components/resources exist: pay full applicable costs and cadence, but suppress its payload before application. Suppressed focus enhancements do not destroy a mundane casting focus. An instantaneous component originating inside, or whose required actual source-to-target/initial-origin path crosses the covered volume, cannot resume that same component beyond the field. A caster outside cannot choose an area center beyond it to bypass an intercepted originating path. Once a persistent source was legally established outside, its later actual origin and local intersection govern: suppress only intersecting portions without retroactively countering the whole old cast. No free list of what failed/which ranks or secret curses is supplied. Leaving/ending suppression restores only still-live permitted expressions, originalHP/buff balances and clocks; missed damage/healing/orders/saves that were unavailable are not queued. Any source that still permits an ending save while suppressed retains it. Ending the field does not refill charges, renew expiries, refund prices or recall dropped gear.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP both source placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose one willing creature, including yourself, perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. The casting range selects that recipient; a separate NEW 60-foot sensory extent moves with its actual body. Combine both preserved placements' explicit benefits into this single identity: darkness, all illusions, invisibility, shapechanges and transmutations. This proposed union does not grant an unacquired school or class mode. There is no save for a willing recipient, and the benefit requires no continuing range tether to the caster.

Within the extent and actual unobstructed sensory path, the recipient sees normally through ordinary or magical darkness, sees actually Invisible creatures/objects, and perceives sensory illusions as identifiable false overlays. Darkness removal is observer-specific and casts no light for others. It does not penetrate actual opaque barriers, physical smoke/fog or opaque mundane material. Blinded or missing usable sight still prevents sight; darkness alone is bypassed, not the Blinded condition. Normal hearing or another genuinely functioning sense can identify an illusory sound/tactile impression whose actual apparent source lies within the extent and accessible sensory path, without gaining hearing while Deafened or receiving messages through walls. An existing remote sensor does not acquire this effect or move its extent; its own express sharing rules must supply any separate permission.

NEW the recipient sees the underlying original appearance beneath an actually operative shapechange/transmutation, including an ongoing permanent form spell. The body remains in its current mechanical form with its actual HP, anatomy, equipment and permissions. This reveals appearance only, not a name, history, alignment, motives, creature statistics, identity documents or lost earlier transformations. A completed instantaneous conversion that now leaves ordinary matter supplies no ongoing false form to pierce. Seeing an original silhouette does not find hidden objects inside the body or restore missing matter. Physical concealment/Hidden still needs ordinary detection; an invisible creature is not automatically found through cover. Once genuinely seen, its Invisible-specific unseen modifiers are bypassed for this observer within the benefit's scope.

For current visual illusions, this is conclusive personal identification without an examination Action. Identification removes only perception-dependent deception and any consequence whose own source explicitly ends on disbelief. It does not dispel the source for other observers or cancel an independently specified psychic packet, fear relation or compulsion. NEW explicit bridge to the unadopted Mental Prison proposal: a recipient seeing through its own subjective prison leaves that illusion mentally; the prison's one still-live ordinary exit packet resolves under its own rule, rather than treating True Seeing as antimagic. Greater Phantasmal Killer's independent damage proposal and Spectral Army's explicit detonation remain capable of damage. These cross-proposal choices await joint review. Concentration ending, expiry, actual removal or recipient death ends this sight. Suppression suspends it while the clock continues. Separate True Seeing sources add no range and retain independent endings; renewed paid casts grant no new knowledge beyond present actual perception.

It can see an actually exposed Invisible foe 50 feet from its own body in magical darkness; the caster's later distance is irrelevant. A second foe behind a stone wall is not revealed. The recipient gains neither a new targeting line through that wall nor the foe's name or alignment, and ordinary companions receive no shared sight.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP five ghostly soldiers, all fake, 6d6 area psychic when attacked, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW place exactly five distinct stationary images at five declared perceived points within range/line of effect. Each fits one 5-foot cube and depicts one humanoid-shaped spectral soldier chosen from appearances the caster actually knows. Images may occupy physically empty space without support, but not overlap one another or solid matter at creation. They are neither actual creatures nor objects with HP; occupied image space supplies no collision, cover, support, flanking body, corpse or inventory. They make only a simple repeated visible noninformational motion and no sound, attack, autonomous choice or sensory report. No movement/retarget command is added after casting.

NEW IP14-IMAGE-TARGET-09: each image is a specific legal apparent target for an ordinary weapon or unarmed attack selected as part of the attacker’s actual Attack Action, with apparent AC10 solely to resolve that real attempt. This exception does not waive a spell, class technique, creature-only profiled strike, opportunity-attack trigger or other special source’s actual target/trigger predicates. Another attack source needs an express permission that actually admits this noncreature/nonobject image; the phrase attack roll alone is insufficient. After a genuine committed attack against it survives interruption and resolves its attack roll, hit or miss, that image is consumed and detonates exactly once. Mark it consumed before resolving the blast. The attacking action/ammunition/command costs remain real; no weapon-hit, damage-dealt, on-kill or creature-hit benefit arises against the image, even on an apparent hit. An attack canceled before its roll does not trigger it. An area damage effect without an actual attack roll targeting the image does not count as an attack for this trigger. Passing through, examination, speech and ordinary physical contradiction do not detonate it. The fake soldiers cannot attack one another.

NEW IP14-SPECTRAL-HIDDEN-TARGET-13, only for an unrecognized Spectral Army image and only to avoid turning hidden actual creature eligibility into a free identity oracle: when a source requires one perceived creature and the acting controller has not personally identified that image as false, the apparent soldier may be selected as an apparent candidate and that source's otherwise legal Action, cost, components and cadence may commit. This does not make the image a creature and does not satisfy the source at resolution. After commitment and ordinary cast-interruption processing, revalidate actual creature eligibility before any spell attack, save or source-effect roll. Actual noncreature ineligibility ends that paid attempt with no target effect and no special failure-reason or true-identity diagnostic. A controller that has already identified the image as false has no such apparent-candidate permission. This bridge is confined to creature-targeted attempts against these five images; it does not modify ordinary casting globally, grant creature-only effects to images, waive a different target predicate, or count as the qualifying ordinary Attack Action attack roll required to detonate one.

The blast is a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the consumed image's actual anchor, affecting every real creature in it with anchor line of effect, including the caster and allies. Each makes WIS; failure takes the shared rolled 6d6 psychic, success half rounded down. No object damage or other condition is added. This is explicitly magical psychic damage independent of believing the visual disguise: True Seeing or successful examination reveals the image without granting damage immunity. Actual psychic or broader applicable magical defenses still work. No blast can trigger another image, because it is not an attack roll and images are not its creature recipients. A single roll has one attacked image; a genuine multiattack can consume separate images only through separate real attack rolls. An already-queued attack against a now-consumed image fails against that missing target without a replacement image or refund unless its own actual source permits retargeting.

Deliberate qualifying ordinary Attack Action attacks by the caster or allies are legal and retain actual action/ammunition costs. An actually commanded companion may attack an image only if its genuine action/profile satisfies IP14-IMAGE-TARGET-09; a printed creature-only Slam or a source giving no actual Attack Action does not acquire an exception. Any eligible companion attempt still spends the real command/offense costs. There is no hidden enemy gate. The images themselves have no companion turn or command allowance; their automatic reactions to real attacks spend their finite discharge entitlement, not an invented creature attack. Maximum five detonations per cast, each consuming one of the actual five images. Disbelief alone neither consumes nor rearms an image. Suppression makes an affected image and its trigger unavailable; retained undischarged images can resume before original expiry, with no explosion for an attack while suppressed. Concentration loss, expiry, removal or voluntary concentration ending erases remaining images without detonating them. One active army per caster; a genuinely formed new army replaces the old without detonating it, while ordinary concentration commitment can already have ended the old one.

NEW IP14-SPECTRAL-ROOT-08, only for Spectral Army: each actually triggered image discharge is a distinct later damage activation. The original caster is the damage dealer; the image has no creature dealer identity and the triggering attacker does not become the blast dealer. After the real attack roll resolves, consume the one image discharge entitlement, resolve actual manifestation prevention and snapshot its genuinely eligible recipients. One shared6d6 pool supplies that manifested discharge; each actual recipient application receives its own new damage root, using the original caster’s actual Null Veil state at that discharge-root creation. Any genuine later transfer/descendant keeps that flag; later caster toggles do not rewrite those roots. A second image’s distinct later discharge evaluates the then-current caster state independently. No root or damage is created for an erased, suppressed or pre-manifestation-prevented discharge. The shared pool is a private engine operation and grants no additional DE4 information-presentation entry. This is an explicit NEW per-card delayed-discharge mapping parallel to the accepted source-specific field/attack mappings; it does not redefine older ongoing effects or make an image a summon creature.

completeCurrentCard.procedure: Action; range 150 feet; V/S/F. KEEP an area appearing as another terrain. NEW choose a perceived supported terrain center within 150 feet and line of effect; the stationary horizontal footprint has radius up to seventy-five feet, so its maximum horizontal span is the printed 150 feet. Its visual depiction occupies at most thirty feet above or below the chosen center, clipped by real barriers and the terrain actually perceived when composed. Replace Instantaneous with concentration up to one hour. At casting specify one static visual terrain appearance based on actual known/perceived shapes: stone can appear grassy, safe ground can look broken, or visible shallow water can look like a dry bed. It does not reveal or accurately reconstruct concealed geography. NEW only background terrain appearance changes: creatures, independently carried objects, buildings, vehicles, doors, mechanisms and actual light sources remain visibly themselves; it cannot paint a concealing opaque surface over them. It may disguise a perceived natural pit or apparent footing, but the illusion provides no real floor. It does not remove actual visual obstruction: a real boulder painted as grass still blocks sight/line of effect and physically obstructs passage. A false boulder on empty ground adds no mechanical blocked sight, cover or collision. No sound, smell, temperature, touch, harvest, difficult-terrain modifier, navigation success or forced movement is created. Observers can make the shared examination or witness conclusive contradiction; an informed observer can distinguish the false appearance without seeing through real obstacles. The image is fixed to its initial world area and never follows a vehicle or relocates with uprooted terrain. Newly exposed ground or arriving objects are not newly mapped or given an intelligently adapted image; actual departures/changed objects can supply evidence of the false overlay. There is no independent image control after casting. Overlapping such depictions retain separate records; NEW at a shared visual surface only the latest successful depiction is presented, with an older still-active one becoming apparent if the later one ends. Knowing one does not automatically identify an independently different illusion. Suppression removes only the affected source appearance while its clock runs; concentration loss, expiry or removal ends it.

KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW declare one fixed 20-foot cube whose center is perceived within range/line of effect, one trigger observation point inside that cube, one finite observable trigger condition and one predetermined performance lasting at most 30 seconds. The entire spell's 60-second maximum starts at casting resolution, not at triggering. The armed image/sound is absent; the trigger remains an ongoing spell for an actually qualifying removal source, without being a creature or independent mind. NEW IP14-ARMED-DETECTION-09: this card grants no automatic visible aura, perception of its hidden anchor, or exception to a detector’s own perceived-target predicate. Current Detect Magic can outline only a genuinely eligible perceived active creature/object/effect within its actual30ft and line/defense conditions; the armed program alone supplies no sensory output satisfying that predicate. An actually perceived running performance is an active effect for that ordinary detection scope. A different source expressly detecting hidden active triggers retains only its own scope. No general dormant-magic detection, trigger password, script, owner identity or remote report is granted. Arming occurs after the cast resolves; a condition already genuinely true at that first observation may trigger immediately, but no event from before arming is replayed.

The trigger can observe ordinary visible shapes/motion or audible sounds within 30 feet of its fixed observation point through actual optical/acoustic paths. It has ordinary sight/hearing only, no darkvision, invisible detection, thoughts, alignment, secret names, creature-type diagnostic, knowledge of events through opaque walls or prediction. A simple conjunction of at most three such directly observable predicates can define the condition. A spoken password matches its declared audible pattern; a copied/imitated matching sound can satisfy it, and it does not identify the speaker's hidden legal identity. The condition is evaluated continuously as real eligible observations occur, not as free Perception checks against hidden facts. If an observation is genuinely unavailable or ambiguous, it cannot confirm the predicate; the caster receives no remote status or explanation.

On the first confirmed trigger, mark the one firing spent before beginning the recorded visual/audio performance. Simultaneous matching events still produce one firing. The performance stays inside the original cube and follows a fully predeclared finite sequence, using only known appearance/content or an actual literal sound sample. It can show moving creatures/objects and speech no louder than ordinary conversation through real acoustic paths; it creates no illumination, tangible heat, smell, support, cover, physical creature, damage, Action or spellcasting origin. It is not intelligent, adaptive dialogue and cannot answer an unrecorded question. The caster cannot amend its condition/script or move its anchor after casting. A new paid cast is required for a different program.

End the performance at the earlier of its declared length or the original spell deadline. It does not loop, rearm, become permanent or get a fresh minute. LR-G07 examination/contradiction and True Seeing reveal its false sensory content for the actual observer but do not automatically stop other observers hearing/seeing it or dispel its trigger. Suppression makes affected sensory output and trigger observation unavailable. Events occurring wholly during suppression are missed, never queued. A persistent state still genuinely true when observation resumes may satisfy an unspent trigger then, with only original time remaining. Once fired, elapsed performance time continues through suppression; on resumption only the still-current remaining part can appear, with no replay. Concentration ending, removal or expiry cancels the dormant/fired program without executing an untriggered performance. One active Programmed Illusion per caster, with actual concentration commitment and replacement rules; no soldier, inventory, collectible recording object or future alarm service is created.

Single-target spells require the caster to perceive that actual creature under its genuine senses. Presence expressly uses the snapshot rule in its procedure. Unsupported body/sense/physical facts remain holds. Cases use declared ground bodies/coordinates and unobstructed ordinary sight unless explicitly qualified.
sharedRules.saves: Use actual casting-class DC 8+PB+casting ability modifier plus actual applicable modifiers, including Wizard School Mastery only for the chosen school. Exact incoming/output antimagic rules remain applicable.
sharedRules.hardAdmission: KEEP the shared source-character/target/encounter hard-denial history. Paralyzed and Stunned are the actual named conditions. If an attempted condition would impose Incapacitated, a previously spent guard prevents that entire new Paralyzed/Stunned condition, with no movement-only substitute. A lawful established hard component spends history once, even if later cured, suppressed, ended or replaced. Independently printed Reality Rewrite experience is separate from Stunned. Named parent immunity prevents that parent. Immunity only to inherited Incapacitated prevents that component, not the other actual parent consequences; when no whole-Action denial can establish, that partial parent does not spend hard history. Initial prevention leaves no banked condition or missing component. Later suppression retains only components actually established, their clocks and the already-spent history. Resuming an established component is not a new admission and does not replay an old concentration loss or other completed one-time consequence. If resumed Incapacitated now makes a genuinely NEW concentration effect unlawful, end that currently held effect under the existing concentration rule; this is not restoration or a replay of the old effect. A suppressed source must still be unexpired and attached to the same live identity.
sharedRules.conditions: KEEP Paralyzed: Incapacitated, cannot move/speak, automatic STR/DEX save failures, attacks against have advantage, and an attack that actually hits from within 5 feet is critical. Current budgets remain separately recorded; ending a restriction never restores previously spent budgets or ended concentration. Neither parent adds unconsciousness, Prone, dropped items, damage, lost memories or death.
sharedRules.time: KEEP typed (seconds,phase) deadlines, never floating .9 substitutes. sharedRules.overlap: NEW Control5 ownership: every committed cast is distinct. completeAcceptedProcedure.procedure:
RW149-A. KEEP one target within 120 feet and the full 24 hours. NEW choose one willing perceived creature, no save, no concentration; establish for 86,400 elapsed seconds. A living 0-HP bearer keeps an already established ward. NEW terminal death or ended creature identity ends this recipient ward; a later lawful return does not recreate it. This grants no resurrection or automatic willingness.

NEW selected scope is RW8-A02 A+B: prevent recipient-affecting components whose mechanical eligibility, magnitude or outcome actually reads the recipient's canonical/effective alignment, AND magical components that impose, freeze or change that recipient's mechanical alignment. This includes harmful and beneficial alignment-dependent effects. It does not include every act of an aligned source, ordinary attacks, faction standing, actual membership, ownership, ordinary character development/conduct, acquisition history, an intrinsic protected source engine, or unrelated components of a mixed effect. Read the actual predicate; titles, schools, faith, appearance and ancestry are not tests. A flat ordinary damage component remains even when a separately quantified alignment-dependent rider is prevented. If a whole indivisible damage component genuinely depends on alignment, prevent that component, not the entire independent attack. No invented base/rider decomposition is allowed where the source does not supply one.

Alignment Suggestion's changed-axis overlay and Alignment Purge's Neutral overlay cannot newly establish on this bearer. Alignment Lock and both actual Alignment Anchor modes' alignment snapshot expressions are protected alignment components; a new such component cannot establish. Alignment Anchor's conduct veto is covered only where its actual condition mechanically depends on protected alignment; independent established conduct restrictions are not erased by a thematic title. A new blocked control component spends no guard. Existing still-live Suggestion, Purge, Lock/Anchor alignment expressions are NEW suppressed, not cured or deleted. Their original snapshots, priority, source concentration, clocks and underlying histories survive. Evaluate the actual remaining pipeline: ordinary underlying lawful records, eligible Suggestion, AP-AS-01 Purge, then the still-operative AC4-ALIGN-01 Lock/Anchor snapshots last. Do not change AC4 itself or its scoped target-baseline exclusion for a later Suggestion. When this immunity is suppressed or ends, expose only the then-current lawful live pipeline, never an old restored alignment. Unknown axes remain unknown, not Neutral. The bearer retains its actual alignment record for ordinary recordkeeping; this immunity does not make the creature unaligned.

NEW alignment detection, reading or prediction that would newly disclose this bearer’s alignment is prevented as an alignment-dependent informational component; report only that the source supplies no authorized answer, not a false alignment or a particular protective diagnosis. Ordinary remembered knowledge or testimony is not erased. Predictions requiring a prevented alignment input cannot replace it with fabricated data or certify the protected outcome; independent supported portions may resolve. Actual rules requiring permanent identity, oath, earned access, physical objects or conduct still need those facts. No ability or item is acquired by refusing its qualification test: the immunity prevents a recipient benefit as well as a detriment when that benefit genuinely requires alignment.

For Alignment Sanctuary's actual opposed/matching admission and an explicitly alignment-dependent barrier, NEW the protected body cannot be excluded by that alignment component, so entry past that component is permitted without an alignment save/match. This is a genuine entry consequence, not a change of the bearer's alignment. Independently physical obstruction, a planar restriction, actual ownership/access permission and every other ward remain effective; an unavailable ownership grant is not supplied. completeAcceptedProcedure.name: Antilife Shell
completeAcceptedProcedure.procedure:
RW149-L. KEEP Necromancy rank 8, Action, V/S/F, range 10 feet and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose a perceived fixed world point within 10 feet and caster line of effect. The barrier is a zero-thickness 10-foot-RADIUS spherical boundary; every boundary point must have center line of effect to be operative. Solid total-cover obstructions clip the magical boundary rather than gaining magical coverage behind them. It never follows the caster or support. NEW the minute is 60 elapsed seconds from establishment. Mark exact occupied body volume, not merely a token center; exterior tangent contact is allowed, positive-volume crossing is entry. No corporeal wall, platform, push, crush, damage, save, pressure, gas, light, sound or line-of-effect barrier is created.

NEW exclude entry of a noncaster body with an expressly established current native living-state classification. Living at 0 HP, unconscious, animal and plant bodies remain living until their own actual life rule says otherwise. A corpse and an actually nonliving Undead or Construct body are not living; an expressly living exceptional construct is living. A generated body is not automatically living or nonliving: use its exact source profile. Identity-preserving form changes retain identity and source-specific current life/body classification, not an imagined replacement creature. A missing/contradictory classification is a hold, not a default ontology. The original caster's same continuing body is explicitly exempt even after an identity-preserving form change; a copy, companion or new unrelated creature is not that caster.

NEW complete living bodies already inside at establishment may remain and leave. A nonexempt living body straddling an operative boundary at establishment prevents establishment after a legally committed cast; no body is moved, cut or destroyed and no refund occurs. Entry is tested for each actual body, including a carried living casualty, independently of the carrier's state. A known indivisible carried assembly cannot cross while any body's entry is blocked; it remains before contact. An independently legal release/reposition is a separate physical action, never free separation by the ward. Unconscious living cargo is not inert equipment. Fully inside bodies may leave monotonically; protection does not trap them. Once wholly outside, later entry is checked afresh. Becoming living while wholly inside permits remaining/exit; becoming living or growing across the boundary while straddling invokes the safe-ending rule below.

NEW voluntary or source-authorized forced entry stops at the last legal placement before crossing, with actual movement/action/transport costs retained and no retry credit. A living limb, natural weapon or head cannot penetrate from outside; a weapon's nonliving projecting portion may cross only if the attack's genuine reach and wielder placement work without a living-body crossing. Released arrows, nonliving objects, spells, air, light and sound are not blocked by this body predicate. Resolve their own source geometry/targets normally. A voluntary teleport whose complete destination body intersects or enters the protected interior is denied atomically at its origin after its actual committed costs. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel has no imagined intersecting beam. Existing inside bodies can teleport out; an endpoint entirely inside is permitted for an already-inside body only when its source and physical fit permit it. Accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 mandatory terminal return retains its own narrowly scoped endpoint exception, then actual physical placement; no new escape or general transport privilege is created.

NEW explicit Falling resolution: if a genuinely unsupported falling living body would cross an operative boundary, the whole Shell ends immediately before that crossing. Continue the same Falling episode, original fall origin, distance, damage root and remaining physical motion. This local ending avoids turning exclusion into a support platform; it is not an automatic extension of Alignment Sanctuary's different exception. A fixed shell does not ride a moving platform. Ordinary source-authorized forced transport stops at a legal obstacle where that transport can stop; if an independently established unavoidable support/body movement would otherwise create an illegal straddle and cannot legally stop, end this Shell before overlap, without adding motion or damage. Missing transport/support physics remain held.

NEW RW8-L04 B: any restoration of an operative boundary, or body growth/eligibility change there, that would place a nonexempt living body straddling that boundary ends this entire Shell before restoration. A fully inside occupant is safe and can exit; do not ejection-search or relocate the center. Suppressed crossing uses the real current body position, no restoration of old coordinates. Concentration and the original 60-second deadline keep running through all suppression. Overlapping shells check independently in stable application order without extra force; ending one removes only its boundary.

completeAcceptedProcedure.procedure:
RW149-M. KEEP Action/120 feet/V/S/F/rank8/base21 and all three printed placements. NEW one willing perceived creature, no save, no concentration, for 3,600 elapsed seconds. This one-hour duration is Ward5 authorship, not an imported 24-hour convention. A living 0-HP bearer retains established protection; NEW terminal death/identity ending ends it, with no automatic restoration after a later lawful return. Actual current Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard access selects Abjuration only; Enchantment and Universal are preserved, fully specified conditional modes, unavailable absent a future exact class-access source. No free union or mode switch.

Abjuration prevents psychic damage from every actual psychic packet, newly acquired divination information about the bearer, and recipient components of actual mind-affecting SPELLS. NEW mind-affecting means mechanically reading/writing a recipient's thoughts or memories, imposing emotion, private mental perception, belief, mental compulsion or mental capacity/attention impairment, determined from the actual operational component. An actual Abjuration divination protection also stops nonspell sources expressly classified as divination; it does not turn all class magic into spells. Genuine nonspell mind reading is protected in Abjuration only when it is actually divination; a nondivinatory nonspell mental attack is not covered by 'spells' merely by its title. Enchantment prevents psychic damage, actual mind reading regardless of spell/nonspell, and actual imposed emotion regardless of spell/nonspell; it does not gain general divination, memory/compulsion or mental-capacity immunity. Universal prevents psychic damage and actual mind reading only. Ordinary persuasion, sight/hearing, languages, voluntary reasoning, personality, skills and nonmental physical conditions persist.

NEW Abjuration information boundary: a divinatory channel obtains no fresh protected bearer facts—identity, current location/body observation, alignment, mind contents or directly predicted future state—from that bearer or a remote observation/query of the bearer. A room scry can truthfully show independently observable room/other-creature facts, but not newly resolve the bearer's protected image/location; it cannot truthfully report 'empty' or a made-up substitute when the protected fact is required. A prediction causally involving the bearer may report independently supported facts, but must withhold any dependent assertion that would certify the protected bearer's state. No all-world blindness. A real witness's preexisting memory or an existing written record is a different source: ordinary reading, testimony and even independently legal divination of THAT witness's historical recollection may reveal what the witness remembers, explicitly as a historical report rather than magically verified current truth about the bearer. It must not access the bearer as a validation/updates channel. A currently warded witness's own thoughts are protected when that mode covers the reading. Already learned knowledge/records remain; this ward is prospective protection, not universal history redaction. Blocked outputs give no false fact or exact immunity diagnosis.

NEW exact component classification for the accepted comparisons: Dominate Person's mental control is covered by Abjuration; Erase Emotion's imposed emotion (including its source-linked fear/rage prohibitions) is covered by Abjuration and Enchantment. Phantasmal Killer's private mental nightmare/fear components are covered by Abjuration; its fear is also covered by Enchantment's emotion clause. Greater Phantasmal Killer's private nightmare is covered by Abjuration but imports no fear. Hypnotic Pattern's mental Charmed/Incapacitated components are covered by Abjuration; Enchantment protects the Charmed emotion component, not an independently specified Incapacitated component. Mental Bomb's mental Reaction-debt and Synaptic Static's mental roll penalty are expressly classified here as mind-affecting spell components for Abjuration; they are not emotion or mind-reading components for the other modes. In every mode actual psychic damage is independently zero. No psychic-only rule removes a separately unprotected control component. A physical/sensory illusion in the world remains visible and may deceive ordinary agency; a real weapon wielded by a deceived actor deals its actual nonpsychic damage normally. School labels alone classify none of these.

NEW eligible fresh components are prevented before establishment/guard expenditure; existing covered live components are suppressed, not cured. Preserve original controller, order expiry, saves where the source still requires them, concentration, clock, original damage root and hard-guard/spent-action histories. No initial prevented component springs into existence on expiry. If an existing mental control resumes, it uses its original still-valid order, never a banked expired command; an already-incapacitating component again prevents newly attempted actions and ends genuinely new incompatible concentration. A previously lost concentration is never restored. This immunity is not a restoration spell for a completed memory rewrite: it blocks future writes and suppresses only independently ongoing eligible expressions.

Friendly one-way telepathy and dream communication that deliver a message without reading or altering the recipient's mind remain legal; thought extraction, forced implanted memory, imposed emotion or actual divination still meet the selected mode's protection even when friendly, self-cast or desired. Consent is not a per-component bypass. The recipient may use the explicit whole-ward ending permission in WARD5-COMMON, then a genuinely new legal effect can apply; no old prevented cast replays. Source-specific dream-plane access and body safety remain held where absent, without invented cosmology.
