procedures.qualification: Exact accepted and applied authored comparison only; all recorded holds remain. It grants no runtime, human-play, balance, cosmology, domain-closure or release approval.

procedure.native: KEEP Wizard15 Enchantment, Action/120feet/V,S,F/rank8/base21RP, control up to3 creatures of actual CR10 or less, WIS each turn, concentration up to1minute.
procedure.targetsAndSaves: NEW MD150-ADMISSION. Snapshot one to three distinct actually perceived creature identities within range/LoE at manifestation; no duplicate body/alias, target swap or future entrant. Each requires an actual source-defined CR≤10. Class level, HP, tier, size, companion rank and similar spell names are not a CR conversion. A known CR>10 cannot be selected; private ineligibility can defeat a paid otherwise legal selection without replacing it. If the record lacks an authoritative CR/type/body roster, keep the entire positive case held. Supplied bestiary CR2/3/5 rows can be exact conditional data vectors but are not operationally reviewed creatures. Initial WIS separately per eligible target; success gives no control, failure checks actual mental/control immunity and source-character hard guard. A genuinely established hard component spends that guard once. Repeat WIS at each regular target END, including the current turn's END when application happened midturn; success ends only this target's matching application. No extra-turn save. Base maximum is application+60seconds; an actual Enchantment-specialized Wizard's printed-duration extension may give a failed-save target+6seconds, preserving every save and caster concentration. That per-target66second maximum creates no additional effect for targets that saved.
procedure.orders: NEW MD150-ORDER, extending only the reviewed bounded Dominate Person interface to this identity. At each admitted target's FUTURE regular START, after all mandatory processing, a conscious unsuppressed controller on the same actual plane may issue at most ONE opportunity order to that target without spending a new Action/BA. The source gives no advance queue: before the checkpoint the controller can plan privately but no binding pending order exists. At the checkpoint snapshot exact legal instruction, target, controller, application, timestamp and known information; consume or reject it in that same opportunity. A turn already underway receives no late command and may reach its escape END before any controlled action. Owner-attached targets instead use the beginning of their real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase, with the same one-opportunity rule. No order is issued outside a real permitted checkpoint. Conscious same-plane mental delivery needs no hearing/shared language/maintained120foot tether, gives no senses, location, thoughts or return channel, and fails if actual outgoing communication is blocked. Each of up to3 targets has its own instruction; no extra turn or shared extra budget is granted. The instantaneous delivery/attempt is serialized before later relocation; if an actual interruption makes an instruction unexecutable, it expires at that opportunity. Failed new issuance replaces no previously established controller.
procedure.budgetsAndExpiry: NEW an order can direct only available ordinary movement, the target's one ordinary Action and ordinary free interaction in that opportunity. Apply earliest valid instruction timestamp, then application order/stable source ID for simultaneous instructions, across the exact accepted compelled-budget interface. A losing instruction receives no second budget or fallback and cannot erase an earlier mandate. Bound ordinary Attack Actions retain their real native attack count; no invented attack profile. Do not compel Bonus Actions, Reactions, extra Actions, spells/RP, recharge abilities, charges, optional finite consumables, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secrets, belief, knowing oath violation, direct self-harm or a knowingly suicidal route. Only normal required ordinary ammunition can be paid as part of an otherwise legal ordinary attack. Use the safest reasonable executable interpretation from the target's actual knowledge; no magical routefinding or hidden fact readout. Unknown safety/profile holds the case. Invalid, impossible, suppressed, canceled, budget-starved or priority-losing instruction expires immediately after this opportunity, executed or not. It cannot bank, replay, become a standing order, retry on an extra turn, or convert to another action. For no valid order the target retains ordinary agency under its other actual conditions; there is no new mandatory Dodge except an actual companion chassis's own default.
procedure.companionsAndChanges: NEW MD150-COMPANION. Keep original owner, original source body/profile, real phase, one-companion allowance and shared offense cap. A valid pending original-owner BA command reservation may be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, never another companion's or already spent allowance. A dominator cannot manufacture an unwilling owner's BA, transfer a chassis, grant a new companion slot, steal its resources or create an independent turn. Without real lawful phase no command/action executes: only END-only six-second repeat-save fallback/expiry. Preserve original marker and map next unresolved save on transition without replay. If required CR or actual owner/command reservation is missing, the entire positive companion case is held, even when other rules are fully authored. Changing controller invalidates old pending/in-flight instruction records; the new controller waits for its own next permitted checkpoint, with no refreshed budgets.
procedure.replacementAndEnding: NEW only one Mass Dominate controller/application controls a given target at a time. A genuinely admitted later application replaces the old for that target only; a saved, immune or guard-blocked attempt does not replace it. Other control identities are not deleted: exact instruction priority and shared remaining budgets govern. Same caster's NEW concentration commitment nevertheless ends its own incompatible old concentration before saves, including all old Mass Dominate targets, even when the replacement later fails. Ending one target by save/removal/terminal identity end releases only that target; end caster concentration or original maximum to release every remaining matching application. Damage alone has no new release save; loss of range or plane ends no established control by itself, but can stop future mental order issuance. Suppression preserves hard history, concentration and deadline, gives ordinary agency where otherwise lawful, and loses the missed order opportunity. Resume only future still-valid opportunities, never reapply an initially prevented component or delete a later application with an older expiry.

A class card with a similar name grants neither ordinary spell acquisition nor a different cost. No printed creature-type/INT floor is invented. NEW single creature for Erase Mind, Feeblemind and Mind Ravel; Mass Dominate selects one to three distinct creatures. Use actual finite identity/body and actual mental capacity for each component. Unknown mental capacity, private CR or defense is not a preflight information oracle. Knowingly illegal declarations are rejected unpaid; a legally committed cast meeting observable prerequisites but failing hidden recipient eligibility is paid and yields no diagnostic/fallback target. Missing authoritative facts in a review case are an explicit whole-case qualification, not an invented success. All selected targets remain fixed for that application; empty selection cannot farm a cast.
commonRules.commit: KEEP ordinary chronological commitment: check real RP and pre-cast Dissonance; limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,actual casting modifier)). Surcharge +1 at limit, +2 at limit+3; ordinary rank 1+ unavailable at limit+6. Pay full actual price, spend Action, perform components, record rank/source/DC and original cast ID, replace incompatible concentration if this is concentration or Ready, update cadence once, then open actual interruption window. Rank8 base strain is 2. Actual Wizard first different prepared family in the encounter waives base strain only; Refrain still follows the real previous named cast (+0 new/different, +1/+2/+3 successive same). No refund or restoration of displaced concentration for a save, prevention, counter or later removal. No unspecified interruption actor is acquired; a conditional dispel/counter vector is held until exact card, access, costs and predicates are supplied. Actual Enchantment specialist School Mastery makes DC19 from INT18/PB5; Divination specialist has DC19 only for Mind Ravel and DC17 for the Enchantments. Cleric WIS18/PB5 gives DC17, RP maximum42, ordinary rank8 strain2 and no Wizard exemption. Wizard RP maximum56. No class-specific passive is silently omitted if the fixture actually selected it.
commonRules.ready: KEEP Ready Action preparation is the actual cast/payment/components/cadence/interruption; any held spell requires concentration. Record perceivable trigger, selected spell/mode and immutable Erase Mind temporal declaration. One pending Ready, expires next regular own START with its original virtual marker. Target is chosen at lawful release; spend actual Reaction only for a legal accepted release and revalidate current target/range/perception/LoE. No new casting payment, cadence or Counterspell window at release. Effect clocks start at manifestation. Lost/replaced/expired hold has no refund. NEW these procedures follow the exact Mental Collapse comparison: Feeblemind prohibits new spell commitments, not an already fully committed spell's completion or lawful Ready release whose required components are finished. An unresolved long cast needing new speech or a new commitment cannot complete while that component is blocked. Maintaining concentration is not casting or communicating. No source-specific release prerequisite is waived.
commonRules.components: KEEP binary initial saves: success establishes none of this cast's components; failure checks each genuine eligible component independently. Use original source DC, without invented degree-of-success rider. Fully prevented/suppressed output creates no saved-up component and no hard-control charge. Component-specific protection changes only its true predicate. Actual Mind Blank Abjuration covers all four spells' mind-affecting memory, mental-capacity, emotion and compulsion components; its Enchantment/Universal modes are not freely acquired, and their narrower protections are not generalized. Psychic immunity alone changes none of these nondamaging components. Charmed immunity alone changes none: these procedures never impose Charmed. No automatic Undead/Construct immunity or soul taxonomy. Hard guard is per source CHARACTER/target/actual encounter across relevant sources: Mass Dominate control and Mind Ravel confusion spend it once on successful hard establishment, not per behavior/save. Erase Mind memory/soft entitlement and Feeblemind score/capability bans do not consume whole-Action guard. Already spent guard blocks only the hard component, with no fallback hard or soft replacement invented.
commonRules.time: KEEP absolute elapsed deadlines and original regular markers through initiative changes, absence, extra turns, loading or caster relocation. commonRules.memory: NEW shared only between Erase Mind and Mind Ravel: completed loss concerns accessible firsthand episodic recall of the actual specified experience segments. Store private immutable original event/time/source/recipient/DC/root provenance and all overlapping loss layers; loss is not deletion of the engine ledger. No world event, physical record, resource, injury, debt, ownership, completed learning, language, general skill, prepared matrix, long-term identity, alignment, Corruption or cosmological fact is undone. Recollection now of an older event does not make that older event occur again; only the current act of recollecting can fall in the window. Unknown/unexperienced/unconscious portions remain absent, not filled with a story. No caster readout of contents, success, hidden interval or defense; no false replacement narrative, forced belief or behavior. Later testimony/notes can produce separately sourced new knowledge, not restore the lost firsthand episode. Ordinary dispel, later antimagic, rest, death/revival and confusion recovery do not undo completed loss. Woven Threads/Haze of Forgetting are closed applied comparisons: their exact shared ten-minute recovery repairs only their own evidenced family portions, not these new losses or Disrupt Memory. A future source may restore only the exact portions it explicitly authorizes after its own access/cost/check; absent such a source, restoration stays held. Removing an overlying Woven/Haze layer cannot reveal a portion still independently lost here. Rollback operations in this data package reverse audit state only; they are not in-world restoration abilities.
commonRules.ending: NEW for independently ongoing local components: track application ID, source character and original cast rank/DC, target identity, start/deadline, suppressed components, original guard and order history. A lawful source-specific removal must identify that exact application/component; do not delete a later application using an older ID. Suppression exposes lawful underlying values/agency only for covered live components, retaining clocks, history and external consequences. A prevented initial application never appears later. Expiry/removal restores only permissions otherwise lawful at that time; do not refill Action, RP, repertoire, concentration, devices or ownership. Terminal target identity end closes its ongoing components; no automatic replay on a later return. Caster death ends Mass Dominate concentration but not completed memory or independently nonconcentration effects. Actual physical consequences and independent effects retain their own lifecycles. No free Greater Dispel, restoration, telepathy, finite attack resource, companion chassis or CR is granted.
commonRules.content: KEEP source/access/content/physical/runtime/cosmology/release qualifications. All fixtures are static authored data, not observed campaign events, new official monsters, human play, balance results, implementation or release approval. Use only actual supplied anatomy/geometry/evidence; missing cognition, current body, CR, event identity, path safety, item custody, exact dispel or repair access is a whole-case/branch hold. Dark-content depiction may be omitted without changing mechanics. No forced player belief, real consent, irreversible PC retirement, private memory disclosure to another controller, or new identity/cosmology doctrine. No source or historical program is executed. All source files, including programs, are retained inert as evidence.

procedure.native: KEEP Divination, Cleric15/Wizard15, Action/120feet/V,S,F/rank8/base21RP, WIS resists, confusion and forgetting the last5minutes, Core Instantaneous. No change to Enchantment school or access is permitted.
procedure.memoryAndSave: NEW MR150-INTERVAL. At actual effect resolution t freeze exactly [t−300,t), irrespective of Ready preparation time or a previously named event. One initial WIS against actual casting-source DC gates BOTH components; success gives neither. On failure apply independently the eligible completed firsthand memory loss and confusion. No second initial save for confusion. Memory loss remains even when hard guard already spent or confusion-specific protection prevents the hard component; a memory-only defense does not prevent eligible confusion. Abjuration Mind Blank can prevent both as actual mind-affecting spell components even though this card's school is Divination. A last-five-minute interval containing a present recollection of an older event does not erase the older original. Do not erase unexperienced portions, change world evidence/resources or invent a new narrative. Missing actual event evidence holds the positive recollection claim.
procedure.confusionClock: NEW MR150-CONFUSION. Explicitly reuse the accepted Confusion BEHAVIOR and budget/companion bridges here, not its geometry, class access, concentration, saving-school choice or separate initial save. This is a 60elapsed-second nonconcentration component from manifestation, not a hidden change to source Instantaneous. It claims the hard guard once at eligible failed-save establishment before any table outcome. Regular END WIS escape, including the current turn if already underway, ends only this confusion; no memory recovery. Future regular START after mandatory processing supplies at most one table operation; no immediate midturn roll, extra-turn roll, suppressed roll or free catch-up. An absent owner-attached phase supplies END-only escape schedule, no table/action. No Wizard Enchantment extension applies to this Divination card. One live Mind Ravel confusion per recipient across casters; a genuinely established later one replaces the old matching identity, but an immune/saved/guard-blocked one does not. Other actual Confusion identities remain separate competing instructions with one shared real budget.
procedure.table: NEW the exact local behavior: d4=1 ordinary agency;2 spend available ordinary Action on Dodge;3 spend available ordinary Action making exactly ONE ordinary weapon/natural/unarmed attack against a uniform stable-ID-ordered selection of OTHER presently perceived legal victims;4 choose d8 N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW and spend only available ordinary movement safely in that world direction up to half current Speed, Action remains the target's. Direction is on the body's actual plane; no invented cross-plane compass. No currently legal victim or safe path/Action gives no execution, retry, target substitution or fallback. Empty target set makes no1dN draw. No optional RP/recharge/charge/special ammunition, extra attacks, forced self-harm or suicidal route. Ordinary required ammunition and ordinary movement/terrain/OA rules still apply; the body gets no new attack, senses, physiology, flight or Speed. Record current budget and actual weapon/target/path; a missing attack profile or safe geometry holds that branch. Table instruction priority is the moment generated; earlier valid mandate may exhaust its budget, in which case it expires rather than creating another Action. Outcome1 does not cancel an independent mandate.
procedure.rngAndVisibility: NEW preserve original RNG event ID, immutable replacement lineage, generating body, separate d4/d8/finite1dN operations with component IDs, stable candidate set, faces and original reduction. The accepted DE4 presentation whitelist's Confusion entry is specific to that source, not automatically this different spell. Mind Ravel does NOT create a sixth Fate presentation channel or acquire Coin/Omen/Reversal. Keep these table/direction/selection raw results private to the rules-resolution state; present only behavior actually perceivable under ordinary senses. No hidden NPC candidate, raw face or event-ID prompt is supplied to another actor/controller. A future explicitly accepted source-specific presentation can be reviewed separately; this package does not grant it.
procedure.ending: On successful repeat save, lawful removal, deadline or terminal target identity end, close only matching confusion. Suppression retains its original time and hard history, creates no postponed behavior and does not undo completed memory. Caster death does not terminate this nonconcentration confusion. Relocation/range loss creates no tether. Rest, ordinary dispel, late Mind Blank or another confusion's ending cannot restore firsthand episodes already lost; only a separately exact restoration source can do what its own scope says. Haze/Woven ten-minute recovery remains limited to its closed family. Overlapping memory edits retain independent provenance and cannot reveal a still-lost underlying episode.

Physical Constructs are not automatically excluded if actually living/reproducible by their own source; HP-only animations, transformed objects and temporary summoned bodies gain no Clone eligibility by appearance. Unknown reproduction/physiology holds the whole dependent branch. Validate the entire root body envelope, mass and missing parts, excluding temporary form anatomy and gear.
rules.growth: NEW the paid instantaneous cast produces one full-size inert immature physical duplicate at that anchor; it never acts, has no personal identity, inventory, class resources or companion slot. Maturity at createdAt+86400elapsedseconds, phase0 before a new death check at equality. No concentration; clock continues in antimagic. Physical matter is not a maintained magical body and does not vanish in suppression.
rules.body: NEW dormant replacement body uses object-like structural AC10 and20structuralHP, no resistance, immunity, regeneration or separate personal HP pool. At structural0 it is destroyed and its entitlement ends. Structural repair never heals the source character. Clone uses the stored body as its local return anchor: corpse-local Mass Resurrection Denial at the old corpse alone does not block a different stored anchor outside it; a matching actual barrier at the stored body does. Old corpse remains is not the paid return body. Cross-plane routing and unknown soul/topology facts are held, not granted by range120.
rules.claim: NEW resolve one atomic claim of the eligible body and identity, consume entitlement once, retire the dormant structuralHP pool (retain its historical damage record but it is no longer an active pool), then assign life1normalHP with present lawful maximum and protected lethal-track handling from the later healing/death closure. No HP-healing multiplier or living cannot-regain-HP effect converts this life assignment to healing or0HP. Actual life/identity barrier prevents claim before assignment. Record this death ID attempted even on decline/immaturity/suppression/occupation/barrier failure; no queued resurrection, delayed eligibility, repeat or replay. rules.conservation: Return relocates the one personal identity into the actual clone body; physical old remains and their actual gear persist at their old positions but all other remains lose duplicate-return eligibility. Concentration ended on death stays ended. Current personal injuries remain functional restrictions on the stored body; an older intact limb is not permission to cure a current missing-limb injury. Actual clone damage imposes its own restrictions too. Unsupported anatomy reconciliation is held; no mass/limb restoration is inferred. Protected Exhaustion6 returns alive and collapsed under later healing/death, not immediately re-killed by maximum recomputation.
rules.suppressionAndTermination: Actual antimagic suppresses only the magical link/attempt, not physical stored matter or maturation time. Ending suppression never replays old death. No indestructible remote soul container or soul-sensing information is granted.
